reference\film\film-equipment.md:33:4.1 Equipment may be used indoors only.

reference\film\film-screenings.md-27-## 3. Capacity and entry
reference\film\film-screenings.md-28-3.1 The maximum audience is 42 people, excluding duty volunteers.
reference\film\film-screenings.md-29-3.2 At least two duty volunteers must attend every public screening.
reference\film\film-screenings.md:30:3.3 Doors open 30 minutes before the advertised start time.
reference\film\film-screenings.md:31:3.4 Reserved seats are held until 10 minutes after the advertised start.
reference\film\film-screenings.md-32-3.5 Late arrivals may enter only during a suitable break.
reference\film\film-screenings.md-33-3.6 Entry is refused once the permitted audience capacity is reached.

reference\film\film-screenings.md-35-## 4. Cancellations and changes
reference\film\film-screenings.md-36-4.1 The coordinator may cancel a screening for safety or room unavailability.
reference\film\film-screenings.md:37:4.2 A changed film title must be announced before doors open.
reference\film\film-screenings.md-38-4.3 Ticket refunds are determined by film-refunds.md.
reference\film\film-screenings.md-39-4.4 The coordinator records the reason for any cancellation.
